**EDA**

```{r}

# prof (char) vs comf (double)

prof_x_comf <- bg |>
  group_by(prog.prof) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(prog.comf),
    median = median(prog.comf),
    count = n()) |>
  ungroup()

prof_x_comf

#
```
